def: In 1842, mathematician Ada Lovelace wrote the world's first algorithm for an early mechanical computer, making her the world's first computer programmer.
Physicist William Higinbotham created Tennis for Two in 1958, one of the earliest electronic video games.

The Apollo 11 lunar landing in 1969 relied on guidance computers that used just 64 KB of memory.🐛 The Language & TriviaOver 700 Languages There an estimated 700 to over 6,000 programming languages in existence, though only a fraction actively used for daily computer programming.
The term "debugging" comes from an actual insect. In 1947, programmers found a dead moth causing an issue in a massive relay computer and taped it to their logbook.
The popular language Python named after the British comedy troupe Monty Python's Flying Circus, not the snake.

Creator Brendan Eich wrote the original version of JavaScript in just 10 days in 1995.🤖 Tech & CultureMoney Code It estimated that up to 90% of the world's wealth exists only as digital data and code.

Due to long hours of problem solving, coffee deeply tied to coding culture, giving rise to the saying, "A programmer a machine that turns coffee into code".Future Literacy Experts believe coding will soon become as foundational to daily life and careers as learning to read
